implementationQuality.summary: All ten round-1 findings closed exactly as declared: the 64-path write set now covers all 31 practicum paths in src/ (grep parity), the five deletable adapters, three new regression-test hosts, the history docstring files, the tracked env files and .gitignore; the Vite-mode 'own' naming decision is fixed; the course bats workflow deletion is unblocked from forbiddenWrites; HD-R2 is specified as a single Connected-driven primary path with a routing discriminator and a mandatory ws.test.ts regression; AuthUser/validators are protected against over-pruning and the password minimum is aligned to the backend contract (>=12).

summary: Independent two-round read-only audit of the stage 12 practicum-cutover package (single workstream WS-LIVE-CUTOVER: phase A adopts the live-smoke fixes with one regression test per finding and closes HD-R2; phase B removes every Yandex Practicum dependency). Round 1 returned CHANGES_REQUIRED with ten findings (five HIGH: grep gate unpassable without the history docstring files, five deletable adapters outside the write set, missing EV-LIVE-1 test hosts, tracked .env.development practicum URLs and the env naming decision, forbiddenWrites blocking the course CI deletion; four MEDIUM and one LOW covering the HD-R2 double-request/routing race, the workstream split, the lead-owned checklist write, AuthUser over-pruning and the password minimum). Round 2 verified every closure against the package and the codebase - write-set grep parity over all 31 practicum paths in src/, the naming decision (Vite mode 'own' and .env.own.example stay; only the application-level mode fork goes), the single Connected primary path with before_id-based routing and a mandatory reconnect test, the worker/controller split for live rows, and password >= 12 matching backend min_length - and returned READY_TO_FREEZE with three advisory LOW notes (stale workstream ids, principles.json exemption wording, .env.development either/or), all closed in the frozen revision.
